response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees), above_benchmark AS (SELECT p.avg_total_rebate, p.avg_net_fee_rate, p.avg_net_fee_rate - b.avg_net_fee_rate AS excess_net_fee_rate FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.avg_net_fee_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_total_rebate) AS avg_of_order_avg_total_rebates, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_of_order_avg_net_fee_rates, AVG(excess_net_fee_rate) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM above_benchmark;

assumptions.assumption: Rows with NULL orderslink are grouped together as the single no-order group; SQLite AVG skips NULL inputs, and NULL net fee rates do not qualify as above the benchmark.
